territories.name: Grenada
territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and a State outside it is a third country for every rule the Directive carries. Grenada levies a value added tax of its own under the Value Added Tax Act, Cap. 333A, administered by the Inland Revenue Division: section 8 imposes it on the taxable supply and the taxable import, at 15 per cent, with a rate of 10 per cent for hotel or holiday accommodation and for the dive activity of a dive package and 7.5 per cent for electricity under the Regulations, a zero rate for the supplies of the First to Third Schedules and exemption for those of the Fourth.
